name: Banzami Developers — public artifact manifest
note: Public, static Sandbox artifacts for the Banzami Developers documentation (PT: /docs · EN: /docs/en). Banzami is SDK-first: these HTTP-level artifacts are the technical PROTOCOL REFERENCE layer, not the recommended integration path (the SDK contract artifact carries the recommended-path guidance), not Production contracts, not live rails, and not regulatory approval. The controlled-preview onboarding and partner-readiness artifacts were retired on 2026-09-12 with the programme they described: @banzami/sdk is on npm and banzami_client is on pub.dev, so there is nothing to be admitted to. All values inside are obvious placeholders.
